shapes.rules: One or two representative inputs. Assert the exact return value, never its type or its length.
Empty input, one element, and the value either side of each limit. One test per boundary, exact values.

functions.name: truncate
functions.notes: The one-character ellipsis counts towards maxLength, so a cut string is exactly maxLength long. maxLength <= 0 gives "".

functions.name: titleCase
functions.notes: Every whitespace-separated word: first letter up, the rest down. The whitespace between words is preserved as it was.

functions.name: countOccurrences
functions.notes: Non-overlapping: "aaa" contains "aa" once. An empty needle counts as none.

functions.name: commonPrefix
functions.notes: Character-wise; returns "" when the first characters differ, and the whole of the shorter string when one is a prefix of the other.
